hypotheses: S0 will retain a large assistant-relative phase0 contrast and prefill alignment advantage.
S1 will show very small unamplified absolute marker probabilities but broad off-phase marker probability under alpha2.
A weaker S1 relative-probability phase contrast may exist; it should not be called the same clock unless prefill alignment replicates.
S3 may preserve more periodic structure under amplification than S1/S2.
Token blocking may improve readability partially while early EOS and replacement punctuation remain.
secondary_metric_amendment: Mean log(P_D(target family)/P_Q(target family)), phase0 contrast and prefill alignment, added after exploration and before heldout scoring. This is relative preference, not emitted probability or independent evidence from amplification.
secondary_phase_selection: S0=0, S1=13, S2=13, S3=0 selected from exploratory unamplified absolute probability differences only; no heldout offset tuning.
forced_context_amendment: Before any forced-marker generation, choose fluent Qwen reference prefixes; replace one token at position16 with original/target/control, preserving token count. Two tasks, two systems, three alpha/model conditions, two seeds, five branches =120 continuations.
readability_design: 64 condition-blinded records, eight prompts alternating S0/S1, one seed, all three interventions at both alpha values plus ordinary references. No human-independent claim.
